text:
Anya: Quick sync — SOC2 milestone: we need owners for KMS/HSM evidence collection and the PR reviews. Goal EOW (Fri). Any blockers?
Samir: I can own the audit log export and evidence bundle. Need retention window confirmed (90d vs 180d) and proof-of-deletion steps.
Leigh: I'm owning KMS onboarding checklist + attestation doc. HSM custodial sign-off still with infra (CC @Devon).
Devon: Infra: HSM team is overloaded this sprint. I can unblock cert rotation but need exact acceptance criteria for attestation. @Anya what fields do auditors expect?
Anya: Minimal acceptance: key inventory, key usage logs, HSM config snapshot, attestation signed by infra lead. Also need PRs showing gating changes (deploy hooks).
Jess: For scope, auditors want: 1) proof key lifecycle (create/rotate/destroy), 2) log ingestion from KMS into audit-log service, 3) HSM tamper/config snapshots. Timeline: EOW for evidence upload, next Wed for internal review.
Samir: Drafted export command for logs:
```bash
redwoodctl audit export --service=kms --since=2026-01-01 --format=json > kms-audit-jan.json
```
Will attach to confluence page once exported.
Leigh: I pushed attestation PR: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/ops/+/4321 — needs review from @Devon and @Samir. Small change: add `hsm_config_version` field to schema.
Devon: Reviewing now. Quick Q: where should proof-of-deletion evidence live? S3 bucket or secure evidence store?
Anya: Use evidence-store (encrypted, retention controls). Bucket is fine if we put lifecycle + provenance metadata.
infra-bot: Deploy-bot: HSM cert rotation job queued — est completion 03:45UTC. Rotation id: rot-20260401.
Samir: Ok I'll export logs after rotation completes and tag them `soc2-2026-q1`.
Jess: Can each owner add checklist items to the confluence page: https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/SOC2/KMS-HSM-evidence by EOD Thursday? I'll collate for auditor packet.
Leigh: Done, I added attestation template and example signed payload.
Devon: I added infra sign-off steps and cert rotation artifact location.
Anya: Wrap-up: owners — Samir (audit exports + logs), Leigh (attestation + PR), Devon (infra sign-off + cert rotation artifacts), Jess (packet collation). Target: evidence uploaded by Fri EOD, internal review next Wed. If blocked ping here. :thumbsup: 
Samir: noted, will post export link + checksum once complete. :white_check_mark:
Leigh: will shepherd PR reviews.
Devon: will prioritize infra job, flag if ETA slips.
Jess: I'll draft the auditor cover email.
Anya: Thanks all — marking action items in the ticket. If anyone needs help with scripts ping me. :pray:
